subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: Anyone who can read the environment's filesystem, seeking prompts, source, command output, or credentials that appeared in a run — vector: An intermediate artifact holding a run's raw output — a spill file, buffer, or partial capture left behind, especially after an interrupted or cancelled run
intent: Content the record deliberately excludes leaks through the artifact instead, defeating FR-5, NFR-5 and NG-5 at once
fit_criterion: FR-8 (derive in flight, persist no content-bearing intermediate), FR-5, NFR-5
